desc:
❄️ The world froze. Your camp is hungry. Catch fish, grill it, SELL it and survive the winter! 🐟🔥

🎣 CATCH – harpoons, giant nets, ice picks, winches… even a whale shark boss!
🔥 COOK – grills, soup pots, pizza ovens, taco machines and giant slicers
💰 SELL – feed the crowd, stack your cash sky-high and watch it rain
🏗️ BUILD – conveyors, workers, trucks and new zones: your camp runs itself
🗺️ 26 LEVELS – every level is a brand new camp with a new machine to master
🐧 COMPANIONS – fish them from under the ice, time the gauge for a stat boost
♻️ REBIRTH – finish every level and start again, stronger
🎁 Daily gifts, offline earnings, leaderboards
👫 Invite friends to help run your camp

How far can YOUR camp go before the next blizzard?

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game for more levels and updates!
